mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(id, name) VALUES(#{id}, #{name}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET name = #{after} WHERE id = #{id} AND name = #{before}
UPDATE sys_user SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ignored_user SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tenant_user SET name = #{name} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}

MERGE INTO tenant_user target USING (SELECT CAST(#{tenantId} AS BIGINT) AS tenant_id, CAST(#{userId} AS BIGINT) AS user_id, CAST(#{name} AS VARCHAR(64)) AS name) source ON (target.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND target.user_id = source.user_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.name = source.name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (tenant_id, user_id, name) VALUES (source.tenant_id, source.user_id, source.name)
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}
